_doc: The derived-copy registry v0 (plan-8018 S1). One entry per CACHED copy; checked by nucleus/copies.py. comparator ∈ {root_digest, value_equal}; kind ∈ {age_graph, sql_table, file}. writers: the ONE builder (globs). reads: database rows the builder consumes besides its roots, from the closed set copies.READS, folded into the digest. also_tables (sql_table): further tables the same copy spans, written by the same one builder. schema: the DDL that creates the copy's container (not counted as a writer). test_writers: oracles that write the copy on purpose. not_writers: files the writer scan lists that write some OTHER target, each pinned to its graph_sig (copies.graph_signature: the sha256 of its graph calls and labelled writes, not its bytes) so a graph edit re-raises it and a routine edit doesn't; a pin excuses only an uncountable file, never a provable writer.

nucleus/social_age.py.why: drop_graph/create_graph(%s) on the people graphs it is handed (astryx_social and its owner twin), never 'memory'

tests/test_branch_check_prep.py.why: creates and writes its own throwaway BcAge probe graph named by a local variable, never 'memory'

tests/test_social_age_design.py.why: creates its own pid-scoped scratch graphs (astryx_sadz_<pid>_*) through the builder's _fresh and a stamped fixture's create_graph, never 'memory'
